cards.title: Indicator 13: externalRatingChangeWl(previous, current) on notchChange
cards.context: Add src/indicators/externalRating.mjs with the named export externalRatingChangeWl(previous, current) -> 0|1|2. Import notchChange from ../ratings/notch.mjs; n = notchChange(previous, current); return n >= 3 ? 2 : n === 2 ? 1 : 0. Do not catch or wrap the RangeError notchChange throws. Pure, no I/O, no new dependencies, plain Node ESM (.mjs). Model it on src/indicators/countryRating.mjs, but note the thresholds differ (Indicator 12: 1->1, 2+->2; Indicator 13: 2->1, 3+->2). Change no existing file. Unit tests with node:test + node:assert/strict in test/unit/indicators/externalRating.test.mjs (TDD).
acceptance: AC-5: off-scale input in either position ("nope", "D", "CC", "NR", "Baa1", "", "   ", null, undefined, "BBB +") throws the RangeError notchChange throws
AC-6: no existing file changed; node --test passes in full; notchCalculator("BBB+", "BB+") still deep-equals { notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }
